status: Wiki startup, folder identity and closed-window handoff verified locally; full OMP migration remains incomplete
findings: Knowledge-library configuration can arrive after hello. A Wiki popup was initialized as ordinary chat, then chat-document failed with Open a Wiki window first. The handshake now carries independent boolean Wiki intent, retaining legacy wikiCwd support.

set_cwd always selected an ordinary conversation and could restore ordinary project history into a Wiki window. It now retains the active conversation kind and selects only the matching kind in the target folder.

A disconnected idle window was rejected as an active history owner while a passive project catalog read or app version lookup was pending. These reads no longer count as conversation operations; disposal still waits for the catalog read and aborts the version fetch.

The Web exit button remained enabled during coordinated document navigation although its click was ignored. It now reflects the coordinator lock; model execution still follows the existing interrupt confirmation.
